info.name: Transaction Ledger API
info.description: All cases from the assessment PDF. Start the API with `docker compose up --build`, then run the whole collection in order with the Collection Runner. Each run creates new accounts, so you can run it many times.

exec: pm.test("System sets id and created_at", () => { pm.expect(body.id).to.be.a("string"); pm.expect(body.created_at).to.be.a("string"); });
pm.test("Account B id is different from A", () => pm.expect(body.id).to.not.eql(pm.collectionVariables.get("accountA")));

exec: pm.test("Page info is correct", () => { pm.expect(body.page).to.eql(2); pm.expect(body.limit).to.eql(3); pm.expect(body.total).to.eql(4); pm.expect(body.total_pages).to.eql(2); });
